notes.title: We like Bugs
notes.notes:
Our little frog had a good start thanks to you. And even if he loves bugs above all, you may not like bugs.

So we settled down and fixed as many bugs as we can. Now the lake is clear and you can go on the hunt.

We wish you a lot of fun at finding and catching bugs... so ..... you know what we mean :)

ByteRockers' Games

notes.title: The new achievements are available
notes.notes:
With this update you will get a lot of achievements with which you can push your Steam Level and hopefully have even more fun with our little frog.

You can now start hunting for a total of 12 new achievements:

Goliath Frog
Finish Stage 4 in Survival Mode.			

Legendary Frog
Finish Stage 5 in Survival Mode.

First Steps Taken
Read all Pages of the Tutorial.

Poliwag
Reach 3.000 Points in Arcade Mode.

Welcome To The Jungle
Start the Survival Mode.

Froglet
Reach 10.000 Points in Arcade Mode.

Training Camp
Finish Stage 3 in Survival Mode.

2 Fast 2 Froggy
Finish Stage 1 in Survival Mode before the Stork arrives.

Gourmet Frog
Reach Stage 4 without catching Special Insects.

Glutton Frog
Achieve a 4x Multiplier.

Make a Friend
Jump on the Turtle.

Adventurous Frog
Catch all Types of Insects in one Game.

We wish you much success in hunting and dont' forget to stay vroggy :)
